name: Besenthal (Germany)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Besenthal (a red cock between reeds on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Besenthal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Besenthal arms — red cock between reeds on yellow
